definitions.explanation: The main woody stem of a tree that supports branches and leaves.

examples.english: This tree has a thick trunk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幹|みき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}っている→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: Children are climbing the tree trunk.

examples.japanese: {幹|みき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{年輪|ねんりん}→年輪：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刻|きざ}まれている→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧。
examples.english: Annual rings are carved into the trunk.

notes:
{幹|みき} refers to tree trunks.

Common expressions:
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幹|みき} (tree trunk)
- {幹|みき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧ (has a thick trunk)
- {幹|みき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut the trunk)

Related parts of trees:
- ⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧ (branch)
- ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧ (root)
- ⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧ (leaf)
- ⟦{樹皮|じゅひ}→樹皮：noentry⟧ (bark)

Note:
{幹|みき} is distinct from the on'yomi {幹|かん} used in compound words like ⟦{幹線|かんせん}→幹線：15069_kansen⟧ (main line), ⟦{幹部|かんぶ}→幹部：06875_kanbu⟧ (executive), and ⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧ (organizer).
